thread:
incident-bot: PagerDuty alert: high error rate on 'redwood-runtime-prod' (#svc-rt-prod). page fired to schedule 'runtime-primary'.
Sam L: getting the page. wait, I think that service is bound to the wrong PD service? this looks like it routed to runtime but the real alerts should go to 'runtime-slo' not 'runtime-primary' 
Jess P: I saw a spike. who modified the service-to-schedule mapping yesterday?
Mike R: I pulled a change in the schedule sync playbook last night — added a fallback mapping. maybe that created a shadow binding. checking PD config now
PagerDuty-bot: Alert auto-escalated to 'oncall-infra' after 90s without ack.
Elaine K: ack'd to stop noise — but this is infra, not runtime. we should not have infra getting customer-facing runtime pages.
Sam L: reassigning to correct rotation. @oncall-rotation-bot can you force a shift to 'runtime-slo' and remove the temporary override?
oncall-rotation-bot: Executing shift. current: runtime-primary -> new: runtime-slo. note: override id=ovr-2025 created by Mike R at 2026-03-13 23:12 UTC
Mike R: ohhh that override was from my quick rollback test; I forgot to delete the override after finishing. my bad.
Jess P: timeline: customers saw 502s for ~7m before the first page. which customers hit runtime endpoints? any paid tenants impacted?
Sam L: quick check — internal metrics show error burst on region us-west-2. likely multi-tenant but top 3 callers are experimental sandbox apps. still want to treat as SEV because routing was wrong.
Elaine K: mitigation done: override removed, routing fixed, alerts now firing to runtime-slo. will watch for flapping.
PagerDuty-bot: Alert resolved by user Elaine K.
Mike R: action items: 1) remove manual override steps from runbook or mark them as ephemeral, 2) add CI check to block overrides that change binding without owner ack, 3) run a small tabletop to cover PD mapping errors.
Jess P: agree. I'll own the CI gate. Sam, can you draft the quick blameless note for the oncall handoff? need to include customer impact assessment.
Sam L: drafting now. summary: 7m of elevated 502s in us-west-2, routed to infra incorrectly due to a leftover override from last-night's rollback test. no confirmed data exfiltration, billing unaffected. top risk: customer-facing latency and error counts.
Elaine K: tagging support to prepare proactive outreach in case enterprise customers ask.
Sam L: support notified. will follow up with timeline and postmortem owners.
Jess P: adding retrospective owner: Mike R (config changes), Sam L (pager response), Elaine K (support comms). target postmortem doc by EOD tomorrow.
Mike R: sorry again. will add stricter cleanup steps.
Sam L: closing thread once PMD doc created. thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
